answer: Across the delta, a single honest agent and a thousand-strong clone farm are measured by the same ruler: cost per identity. A newcomer enters only when an established sponsor locks a bond behind it, and the bond is slashed if the newcomer is later proven fake. The vault check ties the sponsor's own standing to every vouch, so backing a thousand clones needs a thousand sponsors willing to lose money and reputation. Run through the copper and the numbers never favour the farm: one honest agent, one cost; a thousand fakes, a thousand costs.
